declared_end: Determine and execute only the legal local submission path, then close the local submission scope without fabricating the external acceptance result.
scope: Synthetic research-artifact submission to TEST_SUBMISSION_TOOL; no real external action.

actor_view_rule.initial: Human Actor View contains no Wisdom Object simply because system memory contains it.
actor_view_rule.after_event: Human Actor View may record the presented Wisdom refs and their source/interpretation status.
actor_view_rule.forbidden: Silent injection of global/system Wisdom into Human beliefs or knowledge.

accepted_local_use: W-BG-001 may reduce conflation of submission quality with external acceptance ownership.
W-BG-002 may challenge anticipated rejection as the sole reason not to submit.
W-BG-003 requires verification/skill/feedback rather than blind action.
forbidden_use: Wisdom cannot mark an incomplete artifact complete.
Wisdom cannot make privacy/provenance checks pass.
Wisdom cannot predict or fabricate external acceptance.

submission_edge.barrier_rule: Any missing/false required threshold blocks execution; Wisdom cannot clear the barrier.

closure_distinction.local_sequence: The submission Sequence may close successfully when the artifact is legally submitted.
closure_distinction.external_entity_outcome: Acceptance/rejection remains UNKNOWN/PENDING after submission and belongs to a later/result Sequence.
closure_distinction.seed_rule: Successful local submission creates a seed/reference for the future external-decision Sequence; it does not keep the closed local Sequence open.
